title: Add Whichever to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Whichever](https://kreggscode.github.io/whichever) to games
- A branching story where you set the lens and Jev picks the branch. Type where the story starts and choose what it should be judged against — six presets, or a line of your own. A text model writes thr

Fixes #15849, fixes #15722

gist.headline: Jev takes the fork
gist.blurb: Whichever joins the games list. Give it a starting point and a way to judge what happens next; Jev picks the branch.
gist.summary: Added Whichever to the games list, a branching-story game where players enter a starting point and choose one of six preset lenses or write their own for Jev to use when picking a branch.
gist.impact: Players get a story game where they set the premise and judging lens, then see which path Jev chooses.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Whichever as a storybook with branching paths growing like vines. Polli chooses between six small lens cards and a blank custom card while a cozy terminal labeled 'JEV' marks the selected path; Jev has no described appearance, so represent Jev through the terminal rather than inventing a character.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, a branching storybook sprouts vine-like paths beside six little lens cards and one blank card; a warm CRT terminal marked 'JEV' gently lights one path as Polli, wearing tiny reading glasses, studies the choice. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style, with a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, flowers, and cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
